findings.summary: `page = offset // limit` yields a 0-based page while `paginate` expects 1-based pages, so the default call (offset 0) raises ValueError and offset=20 returns items 0–19 instead of 20–39; it needs `+ 1`.
Offsets that aren't a multiple of `limit` (e.g. offset=10, limit=20) get truncated by integer division, returning the wrong items and causing duplicated or skipped items.
`limit=0` raises ZeroDivisionError because `limit` is not validated.
A `limit` above `MAX_PER_PAGE` is clamped inside `paginate`, so the computed page number no longer matches the items returned.
